expert.text: Build SBOM generation, analysis and sharing into existing security processes, with one shared SBOM approach.

lens.cto: Require signed SBOMs and trusted publishing across your software supply chain.

line: Prove where code, data and media come from. Self-spreading worms and deepfakes make it urgent.
scope: Proof of origin for code, data and media, including SBOMs and AI labels. Not reporting duties.
